name: ExportFlow - Gmail Outreach Automation
description: Standalone visual outreach workflow. Separate from scraper workflow. Uses ExportFlow app APIs, Gemini API, and Gmail API. Gmail is called through HTTP Request so each website-connected user can send from their own OAuth account.

parameters.content:
## 1. Generate Outreach Templates
Website calls this webhook after the user fills business plan, tone, CTA, and selects scraped leads.

This branch:
- Gets campaign context from ExportFlow
- Sends it to Gemini
- Saves initial + follow-up templates and sample personalized drafts back to the website

Webhook path:
`exportflow-outreach-generate`

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.55, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

parameters.content:
## 2. Launch Approved Campaign
Website calls this webhook only after the user approves the generated template and sample emails.

This branch:
- Marks the campaign active
- Creates queued message records for approved leads
- Does not send emails immediately by itself

Webhook path:
`exportflow-outreach-launch`

## 3. Send Due Emails
Runs every 15 minutes.

This branch:
- Asks ExportFlow for messages that are due
- Uses Gemini to personalize each email per lead
- Sends through Gmail API using the client Gmail token supplied by the website
- Saves sent/test_sent/failed status back to ExportFlow

Test mode sends only to:
`ibrahimshkeel1@gmail.com`

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.5, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

parameters.content:
## 4. Queue Follow-Up 1
Runs every hour and asks the website to queue first follow-ups.

Rule:
- Lead status must be `initial_sent`
- No reply/unsubscribe/failure should exist
- Initial email must be at least 3 days old

Queued messages become `followup_1_pending`, then the Send Due Emails branch sends them.

## 5. Queue Follow-Up 2
Runs every hour and asks the website to queue final follow-ups.

Rule:
- Lead status must be `followup_1_sent`
- No reply/unsubscribe/failure should exist
- Follow-up 1 must be at least 7 days old

Queued messages become `followup_2_pending`, then the Send Due Emails branch sends them.

## 6. Rebuild Website Stats
Runs once per day.

This branch asks ExportFlow to rebuild dashboard/homepage counters:
- Total scraped emails per user
- Total outreach emails sent per user
- Global total scraped emails
- Global total outreach emails sent

This is only for reporting, not sending.
